items.textToSpeech: The United States Food and Drug Administration intends to consider exercising its enforcement discretion for the following qualified health claims.

Consuming a 240 millilitre serving of a cranberry juice beverage daily, or consuming a 500 milligram serving of a cranberry dietary supplement daily, may help reduce the risk of recurrent urinary tract infection in healthy women. The cranberry juice beverage must contain at least 27% cranberry juice. The cranberry dietary supplement must contain 100% cranberry fruit powder. FDA has concluded that there is limited scientific evidence supporting these claims. Is there anything else I can help you with?
